name: Stream Overlay
blurb: Borderless, transparent, click-through, always-on-top browser windows for streaming.
description:
Borderless, transparent, click-through, always-on-top browser windows for streaming. For
example, you can show your Twitch chat and alerts on your display, over your game.

I made this app because I would often not notice my chat messages on my other monitor, and
I'd prefer to have them come up on the display I'm looking at, rather than only in an OBS
overlay. It's also great for single monitor streamers.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
